story: On the fact that the Atlantic Ocean has two sides (1982) [pdf]
text: Not advocating Alan Kay's view on Dijkstra here, but his answer to this is still very funny: [VIDEO] "You may know that arrogance in computer science is measured in Nano-Dijkstras. [..] I wrote a rebuttal paper just named 'On the fact that most software in the world is written on one side of the Atlantic'."

text: "Arrogance in computer science is measured in nano-Dijkstra's" - Alan Kay ( [VIDEO] ) (I usually like Dijkstra's works but the quote does make a person smile.)
